scope: Only our generated synthetic PCM; no application/UI/CDR/publication acceptance. Exact native9 and private actual browserWorker PCM comparison. Not universal format/rate coverage.

criteria.nativeWasmFramesRateChannels: exact equality, actual first native frame vs first actual WASM chunk; every later native frame/Worker chunk agrees
criteria.lossless: bit-exact native/WASM and independent integer-to-Float32 source
criteria.monoDuplication: the two WASM channels are bit-exact duplicates; each compares to the sole native channel using the same preregistered lossless/lossy criteria
prohibited: padding removal beyond exact decoder behavior
criteria.negativeZero: reported per artifact; no general preservation promise
criteria.headroom: finite float peaks reported without clipping; generated inputs do not establish all codec headroom cases

retainedBudget.baselineRule: All five historical fixture dirs + staged inputs/references/frozen recipe + native executable + runtime assets +256KiB allowance for matrix. Earlier compiler/cache workdirs remain under their existing separate build caps; this tranche performs no build.
